Zone (verified in the model). First-floor plan calibration of the balcony / cafeteria / Upper Founder Space work (X = −18.8 + px·0.029984, Y = 7.83 − (py−187)·0.030273); ray casts into the original GLB (upper_offices/probe_offices.py): wall faces, floor 2.44, soffit 5.00 at 5 points, door and window scans.

Photos. 181–190 (29 Sep, 16:02–16:04), all of them this room (board table, flags, PDM banners). People in the photos are ignored.

Built as new objects. A mahogany boardroom table with rounded ends and 12 wooden armchairs upholstered in red (two in lime), the screen on a stand between the Uganda and East African Community flags, two PDM roll-up banners, the clock, the coat of arms and two air-conditioners on the west wall, sage-green walls, sheer curtains at the south windows, glazed fronts on the corridor side and at the east end with three dark screen panels, a 600 mm grid ceiling with six LED panels, both doors standing open.

Dropped (real scale, no shrinking).

  • the U-shaped table for about 60 (about 14 m of table): one 4.4 × 1.2 m table with 12 seats fits with 1.2 m at both ends and about 0.75 m behind every chair
  • about 47 of the 60 chairs, and the second row along the windows
  • the lectern beside the screen; the bottles, cables, bags and papers on the table (two laptops and note pads stand in)
  • the potted plant in the window corner (it stood where the east 360 node needs its clearance)

Differences from the photos. (1) The photographed board room is about three times longer than the model's room, so one table for 12 instead of the U-table for about 60. (2) The model has no suspended ceiling: a 600 mm grid with LED panels is built at 2.51 m above the floor, as in the other upper rooms. (3) The corridor side is a solid wall in the model; the glazed fronts are built in front of it.
